title: Combat Maids
description: This mod brings stylish combat maid suits and game mechanics into Minecraft!
body:
# Combat Maids Mod
## Description:
This mod brings stylish **combat maid suits** into Minecraft. Equip yourself with **unique maid outfits** that looks absolutely great! **Mod is made for fun**, so **if you have any cool ideas** to further enhance the mod, **we're eager to hear them**!
Mod is made for fun
## Preview:
![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/10f1bcc97fdae23e258bc239fb8e83c1152bc626_0.webp)

## Usage (only for version >= v1.1.0):
To craft you first maid suit use this recipe:

![Maid Suit Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19f0a9ea10fabc6b8f215bcf948ebd157f363a5a.png)

To make it pink:

![Pink Maid Suit](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cfbc1be7b864264fac411e647df04414a721cf76.png)

To add elytra onto it:

![Maid Suit Elytra Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a70775e1449265a0dff9a9a315eaa16fbb31e91c.png)

To add armor properties to it (use any chestplate)
It uses full armor stats from any chestplate you use, as well as it's enchantments:

![Maid Suit Armor Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/547a8da3587c5a3f2c9535fa760ef332f61ddd4e.png)

## Issues:
If you stumble upon any [issues](https://github.com/KViEternal/Combat_Maid_Mod/issues), or have cool [ideas](https://github.com/KViEternal/Combat_Maid_Mod/issues) to improve the mod, we're all ears!
